subtasks: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
Uncover the red block under the center cup. Lift the center cup and place it inverted in front of the red block while leaving the other two cups in place.
Uncover the green block under the left cup. Lift the left cup and place it inverted in front of the green block. Leave the red block exposed and the right cup over blue.
Uncover the blue block beneath the right cup. Lift that cup and place it inverted in front of blue. Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their starting poses.
